0x00089B.en: 「S-so this is as far as I go...!」

0x0008CD.en: 「With the strength I have now...@　this is my limit...!」

0x00093E.en: 「Ugh!@　This is as far as I go...!!」

0x0009C6.en: 「Dammit!@　You won't get me next time!」

0x000BF0.en: 「Hngh! So this is where it ends...!」

0x000C2B.en: 「Like hell I'll fail here...!@　This ain't fun...」

0x000C7F.en: 「I blew it...!@　Nothing to do but withdraw...」

0x000CF3.en: 「Ugh! I've got no choice but to fall back!!」

0x000D69.en: 「So this is as far as I go...!」

0x000DD0.en: 「This is my limit... the rest is up to you.」

0x000E02.en: 「Dammit...!@ So this is where it ends!」

0x000E7C.en: 「No good, we've taken too much damage... Retreating!」

0x000EC9.en: 「Well, I'm beaten. I leave the rest to you.」

0x000F07.en: 「Kyah, the rest is up to you!」

0x000F4E.en: 「The Granzon... shot down, of all things...」

0x000FF9.en: 「Ugh... To think I'd become a shooting star... Ejecting!」

0x0010F1.en: 「Oh boy, they done got me good!」

0x001135.en: 「Hnngh...! So this is where it ends...!」

0x0011A2.en: 「Tch! All hands, abandon ship at once!!」

0x0011E9.en: 「I'm sorry. The rest is up to you.」

0x00121E.en: 「Dammit! Is this the limit of my strength...!」

0x00130A.en: 「To be beaten in a place like this...@　How green of me...!」

0x001358.en: 「No good, I can't take any more! Retreating!」

0x001442.en: 「Oh no! This is as far as I go!!」

0x001480.en: 「Well, well. So this is where it ends.」

0x0014AF.en: 「I can't go on. I'll be taking my leave.」

0x00153A.en: 「Careless of me...@　I'll have to pull back...!」

0x0019FC.en: 「Captain, communications with the rear units are back up.@　They report that Meridem Prum has vanished, but......」

0x001A82.en: 「And right after, the skies over the South Pole@　were covered by Baral's barrier as well.」

0x001AE1.en: 「So without meaning to, we've played into@　their hands......@　What's Baral doing?」

0x001B5C.en: 「After wiping out the remaining Ruina units,@　they apparently vanished.」

0x001BB2.en: 「......Eita, any reading from the Cross Gate?」

0x001BF6.en: 「The high-energy signature is still pronounced.@　But no sign of anything emerging@　from the Gate.」

0x001CE6.en: 「We learned it from Josh and the others......@　She went with Ventos, too......」

0x001DA5.en: 「......Big bro, I'm not going to cry anymore.」

0x001DEF.en: 「I'm... right here, like this.@　Even with Chris gone,@　Cliana Rimskaya still exists......」

0x001E91.en: 「So Chris is alive too.@　That's what she told me... that we'd meet again......@　And Wen, surely......」

0x001F4C.en: 「Liana...... You and Chris are both precious family to me.@　No matter what happens, that won't change.@　And Dad, surely......」

0x001FF1.en: 「Yeah......@　There was pain, and hard times......@　but Father was kind to us......」

0x00208E.en: 「I'm still here too, and so is Fabularis.@　And your Sympathia as well......」

0x0020F9.en: 「In other words, the 'key' still exists@　on this side...... and so does the 'gate.'」

0x00216D.en: 「......I know.@　But there's still something I have to do@　with this thing......」

0x0021FA.en: 「There are still obstacles standing in the way@　of us going on with our lives......」

0x002272.en: 「Yeah.@　We seal this thing away after we free@　the Earth from those people.」

0x0022D8.en: 「So you mean to fight, Joshua.@　Then I'll come along too......」

0x00232E.en: 「......We beat Perfectio, but@　the Cross Gate didn't disappear.@　If anything, it's still functioning......」

0x0023EF.en: 「It may not have been built@　by the hands of the ancients.」

0x002445.en: 「You're saying that even to them,@　the Cross Gate was a thing of mystery?」

0x0024A7.en: 「Yes...... That was here to begin with,@　and for some reason the ancients came out of it......@　and lost their way back to where they'd been.」

0x002589.en: 「Then, while searching for a way home,@　they learned of the Ruina's existence.」

0x0025FD.en: 「They waged war against them, and from what they gained,@　they created the Sympathia and the Race Arcana......」

0x00268C.en: 「And to seal the Cross Gate,@　they built this Fabula Foresta.」

0x002700.en: 「As a result, they barely stopped the 'King of Ruin'@　from appearing...... but the price@　was their own destruction, you mean.」

0x0027A0.en: 「Say, there's something that doesn't sit right with me......@　Why didn't those guys just destroy@　the Cross Gate itself?」

0x002848.en: 「If there's no exit,@　the 'King of Ruin' can't come out.」

0x0028AD.en: 「The first conceivable reason is......@　that they meant to eventually pass back through@　the Cross Gate to their own world.」

0x002950.en: 「Then why not just jump into the Gate@　and be done with it, nya?」

0x0029AC.en: 「It probably wasn't a sure road......@　Like the old Shadow-Mirror, maybe many of them@　vanished before reaching another world.」

0x002A72.en: 「The second conceivable reason is......@　that destroying the Cross Gate@　would bring an even greater calamity.」

0x002B1B.en: 「One equal to the 'King of Ruin,' most likely.」

0x002B4F.en: （In that world too,@　I never heard of anyone@　destroying the Cross Gate......）

0x002BC1.en: 「So you're saying@　we've got no choice but to leave it be......?」

0x002C55.en: 「Destroying it here and now would be unwise.@　We'll need to study it under the strictest guard.」

0x002CDE.en: 「But Baral's garden is sitting@　right over our heads......」

0x002D43.en: 「Yes.@　I'll contact the rear units and ask them to watch over this place.」

0x002D99.en: 「......In the end, we never did figure out@　why the Cross Gate looked familiar to us.」

0x002E0D.en: 「Yeah, plenty of mysteries remain.@　Like why the Cross Gate activated@　at this particular moment......」

0x002E94.en: 「'Cause the 'King of Ruin' came out, right?」

0x002EFC.en: 「You mean the other factor Perfectio spoke of......@　the improvement to the Sympathia@　brought by Alteur Steinbeck?」

0x002FB9.en: 「An application of the T-LINK system,@　if I recall......」

0x00300C.en: 「Lieutenant Aya, do you know anything about that?」

0x003074.en: 「......Even if Alteur obtained the T-LINK@　system data by illegal means......」

0x003103.en: 「why he could not only improve the Sympathia@　but build in an element that would trigger@　the Cross Gate's activation...... that troubles me.」

0x0031C0.en: 「The Gaia Sabers were developing and testing all kinds of new weapons. Couldn't something like that have just come together by chance?」

0x0032A8.en: 「But I can't see Alteur looking that far ahead@　and setting something up......」

0x003319.en: 「Then what if Alteur knew@　of the Cross Gate's existence?」

0x0033A6.en: （So there were others who wondered about this too......）

0x0033EC.en: 「My brother's notion isn't out of the question.@　Even on our side, a few felt a sense of@　deja vu at the Cross Gate.」

0x00349A.en: 「Then Alteur providing the Sympathia@　improvement was......」

0x0034FF.en: 「He predicted the Sympathia was somehow@　connected to the Cross Gate,@　and meant to uncover the truth of it.」

0x003592.en: 「Then wouldn't he come here first thing?」

0x0035CF.en: 「If he had some measure of proof beforehand,@　wouldn't he investigate Fabula Foresta himself@　rather than leave it to Re-Tech......?」

0x003689.en: 「There may have been other places the Cross Gate@　could exist, and he was weighing them@　right down to the wire.」

0x003728.en: 「Alteur watching from on high until@　Re-Tech produced results......」

0x003784.en: 「The South Pole ruins looked suspicious,@　so he staked a claim just in case......@　and that explains the improvement plan?」

0x0037FF.en: 「But I don't understand why Alteur... why the Gaia Sabers prioritized a decisive battle with us over Operation Icebreaker.」

0x0038D5.en: 「In any case, Alteur is dead.@　Pressing the matter here and now serves no purpose.」

0x00397E.en: 「Yeah...... That she had that kind of power......@　I keep wondering if maybe she's tied to Baral......」

0x003A0D.en: 「She left us, went to Baral......@　Maybe that girl and the Custos are......」

0x003A99.en: 「......There are a few things that come to mind.」

0x003AD3.en: 「If Irui and the Custos are connected......@　then the times they saved us were......」

0x003B56.en: 「But after Baral's garden rose, the fish-type@　Custos bared its fangs at us.」

0x003BC4.en: 「Even so, it opened the way to Meridem Prum......」

0x003C0D.en: 「That's because our interests aligned.@　The Custos side with Baral...... they're our enemy.」

0x003C8D.en: 「Irui too...... you're saying she's the same?@　When Perfectio loosed that wave of negativity,@　Irui was the one who gave us courage......」

0x003D2F.en: 「......Maybe Irui meeting us@　wasn't a coincidence after all......」

0x003DA0.en: 「Then for what?@　What was that girl trying to do@　by making contact with us?」

0x003E37.en: 「If Baral really did take Irui away,@　then the reason has to be...」

0x003E9C.en: 「It must have something to do with@　the power that girl showed us...」

0x003EE2.en: 「And what Irui meant by the last thing@　she could still do...?」

0x003F44.en: 「...The only way to know for certain,@　Irui's whereabouts included,@　is to go to the Garden of Baral and see.」

0x003FC8.en: (That's right... I have to go. And then...)

0x004002.en: 「Multiple objects closing in from directly above!@　They don't read as friendly!」

0x00406E.en: 「No, it doesn't seem so!@　The high heat-signature contacts are designated Alpha and Bravo...」

0x0040DF.en: 「Ah! Alpha and Bravo are accelerating hard!!」

0x004241.en: 「That's right. Through our battles with you,@ my child and Galvus grew even further.」

0x0042D7.en: 「The tenth TE Absorber prototype... MODEL-X.@　A machine bearing the traits of both@　Garmraid and Cerberus.」

0x004382.en: 「I told you it was no prototype, didn't I?@ This Galvus is the completed TE Absorber...@ a maintenance-free, ultimate humanoid weapon.」

0x004445.en: 「Tch, first infinite and chaos, now ultimate.@　Every last one of them loves to talk big.」

0x0044AA.en: 「Erde, after all this, what are you...!」

0x0044E1.en: 「I told you that too.@　I want to see with my own eyes where AI1@　arrives once its growth and evolution are complete.」

0x004568.en: 「And for that, I need more than just@　Terminus Energy. I need overwhelming power.」

0x0045D3.en: 「Don't tell me... you! The Cross Gate!?」

0x00460D.en: 「Yes... and that is Duvan Org's goal as well.@　So I joined hands with him... and came after you.」
